the request names `previous_approval_id` (null: the field was undecided) and the field
has been decided again since, the write is refused with 409. With a review token, only
candidates of the token's object (its tender or its award) can be decided.

identity, open a session and go to the app.

this origin, else the root).

schema.title: Response Get Canonical Api V1 Canonical Get

post.description:
Upload a PDF, a .docx or an .xlsx workbook (a workbook or a .docx is stored as its
rendering to a text PDF; a .zip goes to `POST /documents/bundle`) with, where known, the
URL it was taken from and the day it was fetched.
The same file uploaded twice returns the first document with 200; provenance given
then fills what the first upload left blank.

Upload a .zip of a tender pack (Stage 7, Block 2). Every member that is a PDF, a
.docx or an .xlsx workbook becomes a document (an identical file returns the existing
one, `created` false); every other member is listed with the reason it was left out.
One PDF, .docx or workbook on its own goes to `POST /documents`.

Queue the tender type classifier on a parsed document (Stage 7, Block 2 d). One
text-only model call; the answer appears as `classification` on the document: a type,
a state (`set`, `unsure`: a reviewer should confirm, `unknown`: no type fits and the
core sections alone would be read) and a calibrated confidence. Never a fact.
Queue an extraction run. The worker runs it; poll GET /extraction-runs/{id}.

Which tender a parsed amending document belongs to (Stage 7, Block 3 a): linked by
the reference it prints or by its words above a clear margin; otherwise `ask` with the
candidates, and a person adds the version to the tender they choose. Nothing is
written.

schema.title: Response List Agent Passes Api V1 Tenders  Tender Id  Agent Pass Get

post.description:
Queue the independent agent pass over one version of the tender (the current one
by default). The agent container runs it: a second model, from another family, reads
the documents through its own tools and the field schema, without the engine's
candidates, the gold values or any reviewer's decision. Its findings land in
`agent_finding` and never become candidates or canonical facts.

get.description:
One pass with every finding the agent submitted, accepted or refused (a refusal
carries its reason), and the fields of the schema for which no finding stands.

The tender's later versions, each with the fields it states against what stood
before them, and that version's reading to decide. A projection of the review.

put.description:
Persist the caller's assumptions for a model of the tender. Separate from the
model: a read never saves, a save never computes. Never a canonical fact.

get.description: The result publications linked to the tender, each with its approved rows only.

The changelog across versions: per version, the facts it changed (old to new, a
withdrawal flagged) with their evidence, decision date and reviewer role; an
unreviewed version lists the fields it may touch, by path only.

post.description:
Complete the review of the token's tender: refused while a required field has no
decision. Marks the token completed and the tender reviewed, and stores the current
view as the snapshot the gold set is made from.

Queue the extraction of one version (the latest by default): one run per document.
A version after the original is read only for the sections its documents touch. A long
amendment, or one whose text matches no section keyword, is first mapped in full by a
background job, which then queues its run; such a run is not in this response.
`mode` "batch" sends the calls through the batch API for a run nobody waits for.

schema.title: Response Start Extraction Api V1 Tenders  Tender Id  Extract Post

post.description:
The financial model, read-only: the tender's fixed parameters with provenance, the
assumptions (given now, else saved, else the engine's defaults marked assumed) and the
engine's figures, labelled indicative. A free tenant is refused (`tier_required`).

get.description:
The published view: canonical facts only, each with the version that set it, its
evidence pages, the review date and the reviewer's role; the publication state with
its banner; a field without a fact as a gap with its reason and the likely page. While
an unreviewed version touches a critical field the view carries the suspension and the
amending documents instead of values.

The published view as a PDF: cover, facts by section with a reference number each,
the changelog, and an appendix of page references.

The tender as the reviewer sees it: every field once, with what each version says
about it and the entry to decide (the latest version that states the field). Through
a review link that opens a round, the round's scope and counts.
Core's review state for one version of the tender (the latest extracted by default).
The final values of the tender's latest completed review.

post.description:
Queue the summary of the tender, written from its extracted record: each sentence
carries the evidence of the fields it draws on. The worker queues it by itself when
the extraction of a tender ends; this asks for it again (after a field was edited).

A person confirms or corrects the tender type (the answer to an `unsure` or
`unknown` classification). Audited. Refused once the tender has been read, because
the schema a run used is part of what its candidates mean.

schema.title: Response List Versions Api V1 Tenders  Tender Id  Versions Get

post.description:
Upload a document as a new version of the tender: the original first, then one
version per corrigendum, amendment or clarification; `kind` is required. With
`version_no`, the document is added to that existing version instead (a PPA or a
technical volume): `role` is required and `kind`, if sent, must be that version's own
kind, so a change to the tender can never be filed inside an existing version. The
document is parsed in the background; start extraction once it is.

get.description:
The current view: per field, the canonical value from the latest version that set
it, with that version's number and kind. Canonical facts only, never candidates.
